name: keys
source:
screen_init(32, 24)
screen_clear(0x204060)
screen_show()
loop
    let k = wait_key()
    if k == 27
        break
    print(f"key {k}")
print("bye")

name: costly_steps
source:
var a = []
for i in 0..500
    a.push((i * 7919) % 500)
print("sorting")
var n = 0
loop
    var b = a.copy()
    b.sort()
    n += 1

name: sleep_many
source:

for i in 0..100
    sleep_ms(2)
let t = clock_ms() - t0
print(t >= 200, t < 1000)
